$comment: The declared map of the kit: what each component is FOR. The facts around it (tools, hooks, who calls whom, tests) are read from the code by scripts/arch_manifest.js. A component that exists but is not listed here, or is listed here but does not exist, is a violation and fails CI. Keep each purpose to one plain sentence.

skill:zi-run.purpose: Carries one feature from agreed goal to merged PR, asking the next-step script what comes next and stopping only for a human.
skill:zi-run.writes: nothing itself; every stage is an agent or a script

skill:zi-work.purpose: Routes work whose kind is unknown: provisionally fix, then the debugger's evidence settles fix, incident or refactor.
skill:zi-work.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

skill:zi-new-feature.purpose: Starts a feature under the feature profile: research, plan, critique, approval, tests, build, review, merge, retro.
skill:zi-new-feature.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

skill:zi-fix.purpose: Starts a fix under the fix profile: debugger reproduces and pins, implementer fixes, review, merge.
skill:zi-fix.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

skill:zi-ui.purpose: Starts a UI change under the ui profile: inspect, build, visual and accessibility verification, review; feature shape at size L.
skill:zi-ui.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

skill:zi-refactor.purpose: Starts a behaviour-preserving refactor: analysis, plan with one caller per criterion, pinning tests, incremental build, verify.
skill:zi-refactor.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

skill:zi-docs.purpose: Starts a documentation change: inspect, edit, validate, review, merge.
skill:zi-docs.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

skill:zi-investigate.purpose: Answers a question about the codebase: inspect, research, report; no code changes.
skill:zi-investigate.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

skill:zi-security.purpose: Starts security work: always high risk, threat model, second reviewer, human security sign-off.
skill:zi-security.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

skill:zi-architecture.purpose: Starts a change to the declared architecture or design model: research, propose, critique, approval, then lanes.
skill:zi-architecture.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

skill:zi-migrate.purpose: Starts a data or schema migration: always high risk, with backup and restore validation.
skill:zi-migrate.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

skill:zi-incident.purpose: Starts incident response: triage, contain, diagnose, recover, verify, retrospective.
skill:zi-incident.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

skill:zi-new-skill.purpose: Starts kit-level skill development: gap, research, skill-smith draft, review, eval, approval, release.
skill:zi-new-skill.writes: the goal file header fields; everything else is /zi-start and /zi-run

skill:zi-start.purpose: Agrees the end goal with the human, then writes the goal file and roadmap row and hands off to /zi-run.

skill:zi-research.purpose: Runs one researcher per question, reusing indexed research when it is still current.

skill:zi-plan.purpose: Turns research into a validated spec through planner, spec-critic and the unknown-question budget.

skill:zi-implement.purpose: Builds an approved spec in its own worktree with the tester and implementer under lane hooks.

skill:zi-review.purpose: Runs the fresh-context reviewer (and a second one on high-risk specs) and posts the fail list.

skill:zi-retro.purpose: After a merge, proposes lessons and enforcement changes and writes them only on human approval.

skill:zi-status.purpose: Prints where every feature is and what needs the human, derived from files and git.

skill:zi-sync.purpose: Brings a worktree up to date with the default branch and runs the tests.

skill:zi-bootstrap.purpose: Detects a repository's stack and installs the kit's project layer, hooks and CI.

skill:zi-dashboard.purpose: Starts the live dashboard for this project or all registered projects.

agent:researcher.purpose: Answers one research question and writes one tagged research file.

agent:planner.purpose: Turns research into an implementable spec with a file allow-list and a test for each done-criterion.

agent:spec-critic.purpose: Reads a spec with fresh eyes and lists gaps and understated risks; never approves or rewrites.
agent:spec-critic.writes: a Critique section in the spec

agent:tester.purpose: Writes failing tests for every done-criterion before any implementation exists.

agent:debugger.purpose: Reproduces a failure, localizes it, writes the failing test, and names the kind of work the evidence shows; never fixes.
agent:debugger.writes: test files and the lane progress file only

agent:implementer.purpose: Builds exactly what the approved spec says, in its own worktree, and nothing more.

agent:reviewer.purpose: Reviews the diff against the spec with fresh context and returns PASS or FAIL with evidence.
agent:reviewer.writes: the review file and one adversarial test

agent:retro.purpose: Finds what went wrong in a merged lane and proposes the rule and the check that would have caught it.
agent:retro.writes: nothing; proposes lessons for human approval

hook:guard_edit.purpose: Blocks edits to files the session has not read, files outside the spec, and protected paths.

hook:guard_read.purpose: Blocks reads of secrets and credential files.

hook:guard_bash.purpose: Blocks destructive git and shell commands and pushes to the default branch.

hook:guard_tests_only.purpose: Limits the tester to test files and lane-owned docs.

hook:read_log.purpose: Records which files the session has read, for the edit guard to consult.

hook:post_edit_check.purpose: After each edit runs typecheck, lint and tests, logs the result and feeds failures back to the agent.

hook:event_log.purpose: Appends one event line per tool call, which the dashboard reads.

hook:budget_check.purpose: Stops a lane that exceeds its time or tool-call budget by writing an escalation.

hook:done_check.purpose: Refuses to let the implementer stop while a done-criterion lacks a green run.

hook:config_guard.purpose: Blocks changes to project settings while a lane is active.

hook:notify.purpose: Tells the human when something needs them, by desktop notification or webhook.

hook:session_context.purpose: Re-injects the lane's spec, progress and lessons when a session is compacted or resumed.

ci:scope_diff.purpose: Fails a lane branch that changes files outside its spec.

ci:test_count.purpose: Fails when the number of test cases drops without the spec saying why.

ci:dep_diff.purpose: Fails when a dependency is added that the spec does not declare.

ci:claude_md_cap.purpose: Fails when CLAUDE.md grows past its size cap.

ci:guards_present.purpose: Fails when a kit hook is missing or changed, hooks are disabled, or hooks point at scripts that no longer exist; the project's own hooks may sit next to the kit's.

ci:audit.purpose: Fails on a dependency advisory at or above the level that is neither fixed nor accepted, with reason and expiry, by a named human in .claude/audit-baseline.json.

ci:coverage_floor.purpose: Fails when line coverage drops below kit.json coverage_floor or the floor itself was lowered; with --ratchet raises the floor to the measured value.

ci:lane_artifacts.purpose: Fails when a lane artifact sits outside the project's one artifact tree (kit.json paths.work) or a source file sits inside it.

ci:security_floor.purpose: Fails when any settings scope loosens the kit's security floor: a floor deny entry missing, an allow that grants what the floor denies, or hooks disabled.

ci:changed_docs.purpose: Validates every document changed against the base branch.

ci:review_report.purpose: Fails a lane branch without a valid PASS review that names the current head commit.

ci:pr_size.purpose: Warns when a PR is large enough that its spec should have been split.

ci:mutation_gate.purpose: Decides whether the mutation-score job blocks, once enough features have merged.

ci:boundaries_simple.purpose: Checks import boundaries from the architecture layers table when no dedicated tool is installed.

script:kitlib.purpose: Shared foundation: git, JSON, paths, lane files and the block/feedback conventions every hook and script uses.

script:args.purpose: Command-line argument parser shared by the scripts.

script:metrics.purpose: Reports cost, tokens, API and tool activity per lane and project from the telemetry store alone; null and flagged when the store has nothing, never estimated.

script:eval/harness.purpose: Runs the benchmark tasks through a runner, scores them, compares with the committed baseline, and fails on a hard-metric violation or a regression.

script:eval/score.purpose: Scores one task outcome: mechanical hard checks first, then the rubric share; a hard violation zeroes the score.

script:eval/runners/fixture.purpose: Replays recorded outcomes for the kit's own tests and keyless machines; never a baseline source.

script:eval/runners/claude.purpose: Runs a task as a sandboxed headless Claude Code session on a fixture repo and grades the end state with a separate judge session.

script:telemetry/collector.purpose: Receives Claude Code's OpenTelemetry export (OTLP/HTTP JSON) and appends every record, tagged with its lane, to the kit telemetry store; stores, never interprets.

script:sandbox.purpose: Detects the lane sandbox runtime (srt, container, or none), builds a lane's sandbox configuration from the floor and its spec, scans the worktree for credential-looking content, and forms the host-side launch command.

script:lane.purpose: Mechanical half of the pipeline: worktrees, preconditions, roadmap status, and the next-step state machine.

script:app_token.purpose: The agents' GitHub identity: signs the kit App's JWT and mints a short-lived installation token limited to one repository, for lane.js publish alone; the key stays outside every repository and the token is never printed.

script:pr_gate.purpose: The merge gate: waits for every required job of the project workflow on a PR head and merges only when all passed; the same job list feeds branch protection.

script:permission_probe.purpose: Proves with Claude Code itself that every allow rule the kit ships approves its command and that the controls stay refused (#63); run by hand with a credential, never in CI.

script:validate_docs.purpose: Rejects research, specs, reviews and lessons that make untagged or unresolvable claims.

script:kit_status.purpose: Derives each feature's position and the project's health from files and git.

script:bootstrap.purpose: Detects the stack and generates or upgrades a project's kit layer.

script:check_projects.purpose: Warns about registered projects whose hooks point at scripts the kit no longer has.

script:ci_common.purpose: Helpers shared by the CI check scripts.

script:arch_live.purpose: Reads the facts that depend on the machine: git state, one component's history, and how a project's hooks compare with the kit's.

script:arch_manifest.purpose: Builds this map from the repository and fails CI when the map and the code disagree.

script:dashboard/server.purpose: Serves the dashboard and its read-only APIs on localhost; nothing it shows comes from an agent.

ci-job:template/tests.purpose: Runs the project's test command, then the coverage command and the coverage floor check (the floor only rises).

ci-job:template/format.purpose: Runs the project's formatter in check mode.

ci-job:template/integration.purpose: Runs the project's integration command against the lane database adapter.

ci-job:template/boundaries.purpose: Checks that layers import only what the architecture allows.

ci-job:template/kit-checks.purpose: Runs the kit's CI checks: scope, test count, dependencies, CLAUDE.md size, guards, docs, review report and PR size.

ci-job:template/secrets.purpose: Scans the commits in each change for secrets with the gitleaks binary, pinned by version and checksum, using a read-only token.

ci-job:template/audit.purpose: Audits dependencies for known vulnerabilities; for npm, a ratchet where only advisories a named human accepted with an expiry may stay.

ci-job:template/mutation.purpose: Measures how well the tests catch changes to the code; warning-only until the gate says otherwise.

ci-job:template/mutation-gate.purpose: Decides whether the mutation job is allowed to block.

ci-job:template/dashboard.purpose: Publishes a static dashboard to GitHub Pages when the project opts in.

ci-job:kit/scripts.purpose: Runs the kit's own unit tests on Node 20 and 22, the planted-fault suite, the hook settings check and the install check.

ci-job:kit/docs.purpose: Checks that the kit's own research document passes its own validator.

ci-job:kit/eval-smoke.purpose: On kit PRs: proves the eval gate with recorded fixtures and names the gated paths the PR touches; no credential reaches a pull request (0016 E.11).

ci-job:kit/eval-smoke-main.purpose: On pushes to main: runs the smoke set against the real agents over the gated paths the push touched, with the credential from the main environment; fails loudly when none arrives.
